metal_d50_um.what: metal grain size in ordinary chondrites

locked_fes.what: share of troilite intergrown with metal at coarse grind

locked_sil.what: share of silicate mass carried at coarse grind

mag_recovery.what: metal recovery of magnetic separation when liberated

tau_h2_h.what: H2 desulfurisation time constant, 100 µm troilite at 900 °C

h2_approach.what: approach to H2S/H2 equilibrium in the bed

gamma_sulfide.what: surface tension of Fe–S liquid, N/m

wetting_cos.what: cosine of the contact angle of Fe–S liquid on metal

incl_d50_um.what: silicate inclusion / metal droplet size in the melt

ls_native.what: S partition slag/metal for FeO-bearing chondritic slag

ls_flux.what: S partition with CaO-rich reducing slag

k_vac_S.what: vacuum S evaporation rate constant, m/s

tau_carb_h.what: Fe carbonylation time constant, 100 µm at 100 bar, 175 °C

co_loss.what: CO lost (leaks, side reactions) per unit of CO bound to product

eps_eff.what: effective emissivity of the shielded furnace shell

bond_wi.what: Bond work index of chondritic silicate, kWh/t

refractory_melt.what: refractory wear in melt routes, kg per t metal

mill_wear.what: grinding media wear, kg per t ROM at 300 µm
